chunks: And Abū Baṣīr narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:

It is proper for the one responsible for the funeral not to wear a cloak, and to be in a shirt so that he may be recognized; and it is proper for his neighbors to provide food on his behalf for three days.

key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral or bier of the deceased
key_terms.رِدَاءً: an outer cloak or wrap garment

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teach about funeral mourning etiquette and the role of neighbors?
ai.summary: This hadith describes recommended mourning etiquette for the one attending closely to the جنازة, including appearing in a recognizable state of grief. It also establishes a social duty of support, namely that neighbors should provide food for the bereaved household for three days.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.509 - Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"It is proper for the person responsible for the funeral (i.e., the chief mourner) not to wear an outer cloak (ridā') and to remain in a shirt (Qamis) so that they are recognized (as grieving). It is also proper for the neighbors to provide food on their behalf for three days.”
